newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council to agree texts on women's opportunities.
newsitem.headline: Council to agree texts on women's opportunities.

text.p: The Social Affairs Council is expected to agree two texts on Tuesday aimed at promoting opportunities for women.
It will not be able to adopt them formally, however, because Britain needs to consult its parliament first, EU officials said.
The first text is a draft recommendation, COM(95)593, asking governments to promote the "balanced" participation of men and women in decision-making by public and private bodies.
Britain blocked the Council from adopting it in June as part of its protest against the EU ban on beef exports because of mad cow disease.

The second text is a draft resolution introduced by the Irish presidency asking member states and the Commission to ensure that women have an equal chance with men to benefit from and make decisions about EU structural funds.
